name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plugin that keeps AI coding assistants from 'forgetting' your project and stops them from choking on huge wall-of-text tool output.
buyer: A professional software developer who pays for an AI coding assistant subscription and is frustrated it re-explains itself or loses context every session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer installs it so their AI coding agent remembers project conventions and prior decisions across sessions instead of re-asking every time.
An engineering team standardizes on it to keep every developer's AI agent output consistent and within token budget across 17 supported tools.
A dev-tools consultancy bundles it into client onboarding so a new AI coding setup works efficiently from day one.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a team/enterprise tier with shared configuration, usage dashboards, and support.
Charge for a hosted session-memory backend instead of local storage, priced per seat.

steal_this: This is a developer-productivity plugin, not really a standalone business on its own; the fastest 'steal' is just installing it to make your own AI coding workflow cheaper and better.
